title: SRS Relation
description: A single Relation stored as a standalone object at relations/<relationId>.json (RFC-038 Change E, [R11]). The in-file relationId is authoritative; a filename disagreeing with it is an error. Creating, updating, or deleting one Relation must not read or write any other Relation's file.

relationType.description: Canonical types: contains, depends-on, supersedes, refines, derived-from, evidences, precedes. Custom types use namespace/name format.

sourceInstanceId.description: The asserting instance. Reads: source [relationType] target.

createdBy.description: RFC-046. The actor that created this instance, stamped by the implementation from the session actor at creation and never taken from a request. Optional: absent means unattributed, never invalid, and no actor is inferred. Set once and preserved by every other operation. Testimony, never authority: it never affects validity.

Actor.description: RFC-046 [R1]. Who performed an act. Exactly kind and id are required; no other property is allowed. The $defs/Actor entry is repeated byte-identically in record.json, note.json and relation.json (checked by scripts/check-actor-defs-identical.mjs). Testimony, never authority: it informs trust and diagnosis and never affects validity (RFC-046 [R8]).

kind.description: human: a person stands directly behind the act. ai: an AI agent performed it, even when a person started or supervises it. These are the actor values of FieldMeta.source: one actor vocabulary (RFC-046 [R9]).

id.description: Stable, opaque identifier issued by whatever authenticated the session. Compared by exact string equality and carries no other meaning (RFC-046 [R7]).

name.description: Display label captured when the stamp was made. A hint only: it may go stale and never identifies; on disagreement the id wins.

sourceId.description: Free-form when sourceType is transcript-chunk/transcript-segment/external-document. When sourceType is repository-document, MUST be a SourceDocument.documentId (format: uuid, RFC-017) — enforced by the sibling if/then.

sourceRole.description: The role the source material plays for this instance (RFC-023). Replaces relationType. 'attaches' added by RFC-017: material attachment of a source document to a record (RFC-017 [R1]).
